description:
Recorded ownership, title and agency relationships around ONE company or title (mode=network), or a recorded
    path from it to a second record (mode=path, which needs `to_kind` and `to_id`). `anchor_id` is a canonical id taken
    from another tool's result, never a name or text. `depth` 1 to 3; `limit` at most 100 nodes fetched; the answer is
    paged `page_size` (default 25, at most 100) at a time via `next_cursor`, each node with its outgoing edges and
    provenance. Requires the customer's own account (a shared preview key is refused with 401).

    The graph is bounded and eventually consistent: only W14 assets are projected so far, there are no PSC links and
    the overseas flag is never set. A clipped answer says `truncated`. An absent link is NOT "no owner", "no
    relationship" or "off market": say it is not recorded. Individuals are removed together with their links. Do NOT
    use it for a valuation or to find people. An unpublished root, an empty graph and a failure are not charged.
    Costs 15 credits (15p).
name: ownership_links
title: Bounded ownership network or path
